HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android UI page class extending SmartFlow. It provides comprehensive automation methods for interacting with the HP printer details screen, including navigation through printer tiles (camera scan, print photos, scan, print documents, copy, mobile fax, shortcuts, printables, print quality tools), managing product information, printer settings, reports, device management, and scan operations. The class uses swipe gestures to locate elements and offers verification methods for UI elements with configurable timeout and exception handling.
